disbursements_unbilled_idx.name: disbursements_unbilled_idx
disbursements_unbilled_idx.where: "disbursements"."billable" and "disbursements"."invoice_line_id" is null and "disbursements"."deleted_at" is null

invoices_issued_check.name: invoices_issued_check
invoices_issued_check.value: "invoices"."status" = 'draft' or ("invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."issue_date" is not null)

invoices_note_check.name: invoices_note_check
invoices_note_check.value: "invoices"."type" not in ('credit_note', 'debit_note') or "invoices"."original_invoice_id" is not null

clients_pan_key.name: clients_pan_key
clients_pan_key.where: "clients"."pan" is not null and "clients"."deleted_at" is null

contacts_din_key.name: contacts_din_key
contacts_din_key.where: "contacts"."din" is not null and "contacts"."deleted_at" is null

invitations_target_check.name: invitations_target_check
invitations_target_check.value: ("invitations"."kind" = 'firm_member' and "invitations"."role_id" is not null) or ("invitations"."kind" = 'client_user' and "invitations"."client_id" is not null)

time_entries_unbilled_idx.name: time_entries_unbilled_idx
time_entries_unbilled_idx.where: "time_entries"."billable" and "time_entries"."invoice_id" is null and "time_entries"."deleted_at" is null
